webSearch.baseUrl.label: SearXNG Base URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Optional override for the managed local SearXNG URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:3210 or https://search.example.com/searxng.

webSearch.autoStart.label: Auto-start managed daemon
webSearch.autoStart.help: Start the bundled local SearXNG sidecar when web_search needs it.

webSearch.host.label: Managed daemon host
webSearch.host.help: Loopback host used for the managed local SearXNG sidecar.

webSearch.port.label: Managed daemon port
webSearch.port.help: Loopback port used for the managed local SearXNG sidecar.

webSearch.startupTimeoutMs.label: Managed daemon startup timeout
webSearch.startupTimeoutMs.help: How long CrawClaw waits for the managed local SearXNG sidecar to become ready.

webSearch.healthPath.label: Managed daemon health path
webSearch.healthPath.help: HTTP path CrawClaw probes before starting the managed local SearXNG sidecar.

webSearch.categories.label: SearXNG Categories
webSearch.categories.help: Optional comma-separated categories such as general, news, or science.

webSearch.language.label: SearXNG Language
webSearch.language.help: Optional language code for results such as en, de, or fr.
